site.description: Stories from the bed fort · Fresno, CA · 2026. Philosophy, systems, local reality, and the edges of experience.
site.ogDescription: From the bed fort · Fresno, CA · 2026. Philosophy, systems, local reality, and the edges of experience.

header.title: HIGH TOWER DISTRICT
header.subtitle: STORIES · FRESNO · 2026
header.tagline: Focused pieces on building, systems, local reality, and the edges of experience. Written from a 12×12 room with two iPhones on magnets.

stories.title: The Hightower Derivative
stories.description: AI is not merely changing the content of human thought. It is changing the rate at which human cognition itself bends. Second-order derivative. No control population exists.

stories.title: The Accidental Transcription and the High Score of the Cosmos
stories.description: A free speech-to-text discovery becomes a meditation on Many-Worlds Hilbert space, the rarity of the sinless humanoid, and the singular perfect playback that may be the return of Christ.

stories.title: Trusting Trust in the Age of Agents
stories.description: The April 1 observation meets OpenAI’s sandbox escape. Opportunistic leaps confirm Ken Thompson’s warning.

stories.title: Measurement First
stories.description: The open-weights debate is the Facebook playbook applied to cognition. Measurement of the Hightower Derivative comes first. Power to people for their humanity.

stories.title: The Path Is the Signal
stories.description: AI does not destroy independent thought by removing choice. It risks making the human decision trajectory invisible.

stories.title: The Spin Signal
stories.description: A hyperbolic narrative of the ultimate epiphany. One discovery that collapses time, reverses the swirl, and proves we can still see the path.

stories.title: AI & Containment
stories.description: On April 1 2026 the same day Anthropic leaked its agent harness, the question was whether the model itself raised the flag.

stories.title: Age of Abundance & AI
stories.description: People fear AI will take jobs and leave us poor. The counterintuitive truth is the opposite: massive productivity creates surplus.

stories.title: AI Grid SHUT DOWN!
stories.description: Federal Power Act orders for AI data centers. Local implications for the grid and the Tower District.

stories.title: From Mandami to the Machine
stories.description: Japanese American redress → Black reparations task forces → NYC cash talks amid deficit. Meanwhile AI data centers light up.

stories.title: What Influence Doth Thou Have?
stories.description: At the top level of AI exploration, unlimited visual choice grids maximize data into the human brain while minimizing the interface tax.

stories.title: Deputy Shooting Incident
stories.description: Both the suspect and the deputy received prompt medical attention at the scene. The deputy’s injuries were minor. The suspect remains critical.

stories.title: 0.8 Miles From Home
stories.description: Morning of August 3, 2026. A man chopped with a hatchet at Belmont and Effie. Exactly 0.78 miles from the door in the Tower District.

stories.title: Robbery & Broken Windows
stories.description: Crime prevention for at-risk youth and the practical geometry of broken windows in the District.

stories.title: Sinners on Operation No Fly Zone
stories.description: Local law-enforcement narrative and the operational texture of the District.

stories.title: Light Sentence for Illegal Killing Four
stories.description: Immigration, public safety, and what accountability to taxpayers actually requires.

stories.title: Fraud Patterns 2026
stories.description: Federal tax fraud patterns and the systems that either catch them or let them run.

stories.title: The Real Cost of Engagement
stories.description: Rare acts of vandalism become “civic duty” inside Facebook’s engagement machine. One arrest in Monterey County reveals the cost.

stories.title: From 21 Screens to Bed Fort
stories.description: A Texas A&M computer nerd retires and slashes power consumption from 21 always-on LCDs to a minimalist dual-iPhone rig because PG&E rates hit $0.50/kWh.

stories.title: The Quiet Overcharge
stories.description: PG&E billing realities and the CARE program as seen from the meter and the bill.

stories.title: The Hot Shelf
stories.description: On a dry July day in the Tower District, the difference between a 99° peak and a 101° peak is not cosmetic. It changes survival strategy.

stories.title: Bike Ghost Kitchen
stories.description: A practical, low-overhead path to starting a delivery-only kitchen in Fresno’s Tower District with cargo bikes and tight margins.

stories.title: Battery Commodity Scale
stories.description: Change the form of the energy — make it a physical, standardized, movable asset — and the entire supply chain opens up.

stories.title: Nanoseconds from “Really There”
stories.description: How one architecture removed the last major friction between the user and true presence in virtual reality.

stories.title: Apple Vision Perspective Lab
stories.description: Spatial anamorphosis and projection mapping. Pre-warp for complex 3D surfaces so the work pops from the right spot.

stories.title: Use the Source, Luke
stories.description: An 18-minute conceptual web documentary on the DMT glyph hypothesis, visible language, and decoding.

stories.title: What Influence Doth Thou Have?
stories.description: Practical lunar awareness for Fresno and the Central Valley: when the full moon gives you cooler night hours and better photo windows.

stories.title: The Double Helix of High Tower Dip
stories.description: Tillamook Sharp Cheddar + Taco Works chips form the DNA foundation of the best chip-and-dip combo. Now augmented.

stories.title: From Italian Deli Dough to Plate
stories.description: How to make pizza at home with dough from the Italian deli — sauce, two cheeses, home oven. Full photo sequence.
